messages:
avi: Quick design review please 1: new Playground mock: https://figma.com/file/abc/playground-token-stop. Main questions: where to surface stop/regenerate, how visible should token meter be during streaming, and prompt library pin UX (drag-to-pin vs toggle). Want quick reactions.

mia: Nice! my gut: make stop very discoverable during long streams. Two options: 1) subtle inline pill that appears on hover/focus, 2) small persistent icon inside bubble. Both should have keyboard focus.

sam: Another idea: keyboard shortcut (Esc to stop, Cmd+R to regen) + visible UI affordance. Keyboard-first helps power users and reduces visual clutter.

kevin: a11y requirements: stop control must be in the tab order and have a descriptive aria-label ("Stop generation"). Streaming text should live in an aria-live region set to polite. If we update token meter frequently, ensure VoiceOver doesn't read every increment (debounce to ~300-500ms).

alisa: QA concerns: inline persistent icon risks overlapping the copy/selection affordances. If we animate in/out, test pointer events so selection isn't interfered with. Also test with mobile talkback.

avi: microcopy: token meter abbreviations like "324 tok" are fine, but tooltip/expanded state should read "Tokens used: 324". For regen confirm, show a short toast: "Generating new response from the same prompt..." not modal.

sam: implementation note: token count can be pushed from backend every 250ms. For low-bandwidth fallback, show an indeterminate spinner in place of count. Animation idea: pulse the token badge while streaming to indicate activity, but ensure reduced-motion preference disables pulse.

mia: prompt library pin patterns: Drag a card to the rail to pin, or a pin toggle on the card. I prefer drag for discoverability, but add a small pin icon for keyboard users.

kevin: confirm drag pattern accessibility: for keyboard, allow card selection + press 'P' or use a context menu action "Pin to rail". Also announce via live region when pinned: "Prompt pinned to library".

product-bot: automated preview uploaded: https://img.redwood.dev/playground_preview_v3.gif (shows inline persistent icon + token badge top-left).

alisa: test matrix I want added: keyboard-only stop, token badge focus + tooltip, reduced-motion (no pulse), mobile narrow viewport (ensure inline icon hidden and global toolbar visible), drag-to-pin keyboard alternative. Add to TKT-772.

sam: vote: :one: show small persistent inline icon + keyboard shortcuts, hide on very small screens and surface floating global toolbar.

mia: :one: for inline persistent icon. Add fallback: global toolbar below 600px.

kevin: :one: but enforce aria-labels and polite live region. Also require debounce on token updates to prevent SR spam.

avi: :one: + add product note: on intermittent streams, prefer showing spinner vs numbers until stable.

alisa: tests added. I'll pair with sam for e2e keyboard flows.

avi: action items: sam to prototype keyboard shortcuts + CSS for inline icon; kevin to write a11y checklist (aria labels, live regions, reduced-motion); alisa to add tests to sprint; mia to update figma with drag-to-pin and keyboard pin action. Target: ship in next minor.

sam: opening branch feature/playground-stop-shortcuts and will tag reviewers.

kevin: will PR accessibility doc in the PR comments.

mia: thanks all, closing thread.
